title: SRM Medical College Hospital Hosts CME on Contemporary Breast Cancer Management
summary: SRM Medical College Hospital & Research Centre, Kattankulathur, held a two-day CME on contemporary breast cancer management as part of SRM Pink October 2026.
body_html:
Chennai, 31 October 2026: SRM Medical College Hospital & Research Centre (SRMMCHRC), part of SRM Institute of Science and Technology, Kattankulathur, has begun a two-day Continuing Medical Education (CME) programme on “Contemporary Breast Cancer Management”. The programme was inaugurated on October 30, 2026, at the Hippocrates Auditorium in the SRM Medical College Building, Kattankulathur, as part of SRM Pink October 2026, which is being observed during Breast Cancer Awareness Month.

The CME has been jointly organised by the Departments of General Surgery and Surgical Oncology. It brings together medical professionals, specialists and academicians to discuss recent advances, changing treatment approaches and multidisciplinary perspectives in breast cancer care. The programme is built around the theme “Preserve • Reshape • De-escalate • Optimise”, with a focus on improving clinical outcomes while keeping patient-centred care at the forefront.

Dr. Shashanka Mohan Bose, Chairman, Academic Committee, Council of NAMS, and former Senior Professor and Head of the Department of Surgery, PGI, Chandigarh, attended the inaugural function as Chief Guest.

Speaking at the event, Dr. R. Jayanthi, Dean (Medical), SRM Medical College Hospital & Research Centre, said “every one of us must act as a social ambassador for sensitising the public in early detection of breast cancer, spreading awareness among our families and communities, and encouraging women to prioritise self-breast examination.”

In his inaugural address, Dr. R. Venkatraman, Medical Superintendent, SRMMCHRC, said “we aim to expand our screening initiatives across all faculties and employees of SRM IST, creating greater awareness and ensuring access to appropriate screening methods for the well-being of our entire community.”

The opening day also included an expert session by Dr. Veda Padma Priya, Senior Consultant, Breast Oncology, MGM Cancer Institute, Chennai, titled “Shaping the Breast: The Art & Science of Oncoplastic Surgery – Masterclass & Demonstration”, which looked at the growing role of oncoplastic surgical approaches in treating breast cancer.

Running on October 30 and 31, 2026, the CME includes expert lectures, surgical video masterclasses, multidisciplinary discussions and evidence-based updates. The scientific sessions cover locally advanced breast cancer, breast conservation, oncoplastic surgery, surgical techniques and axillary de-escalation strategies, with national and institutional faculty members taking part in knowledge exchange and academic collaboration.

Through SRM Pink October 2026, the hospital said it is reaffirming its commitment to breast cancer awareness, early detection and comprehensive, patient-centred cancer care.
